What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka]]: left, the image of [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka (Errata)]] (holotable commit 0ab9fb8); right, the image of [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 4ab16f9). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0ab9fb866cb766f1913af967a4ab9b30668559cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4ab16f9b9c15499d865b4a7165ea8ddb0f451253/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
